captures.what_is_new: Commission page, 19 Oct 2026 (last update 21 Oct): the reference to EN 18286:2026 (CEN and CENELEC), a quality management system standard for providers of high-risk AI systems, is published in the Official Journal through Implementing Decision (EU) 2026/2274; providers applying it get a presumption of conformity with the AI Act's Article 17 requirements it covers; it is mapped to Article 17, built around the AI system lifecycle, to be layered on ISO/IEC 42001, ISO 9001 or a sectoral system; further harmonised standards are expected.
